examples.name: Sample — a filing stamp over a print header
paragraphs: A web page printed to PDF, then filed: the blue filing stamp sits directly on the grey browser header line, and the two are unreadable as one string. Read apart, both are legible. The footer URL and 2/2 are untouched.

snippets.text:
[stamp: Case 4:19-cv-00892-HSG Document 36-4 Filed 04/04/19 Page 3 of 3]

4/4/2019 Presidential Proclamation on Declaring a National Emergency Concerning the Southern Border of the United States | The White House

examples.name: Sample — two filing stamps over a print header
paragraphs: An exhibit divider page — EXHIBIT D alone — whose header carries the clerk's boxed FILED stamp over the header's own FILED:, and Index # over INDEX NO., both overprinted. Everything but the page count at the foot is set in bold.

snippets.text:
[stamp: FILED]

FILED: HALVERSTON COUNTY CLERK 03/14/2026 11:05 AM
[stamp: Index #: E2026004417]
INDEX NO. E2026004417
HCEF DOC. NO. 2
RECEIVED HCEF: 03/14/2026
EXHIBIT D
56 of 61

examples.name: Sample — three headers on one line
paragraphs: A browser print header, an e-filing stamp and the article's own Page 22 of 37 all printed at the top of a nearly empty page, on top of each other. The browser timestamp is legible up to 09; the characters after it lie under the stamp's opening Ca and are left out.
